dataTypes.official: Directly obtained from an authoritative dataset (EIA, PPAC, ISPRL, IEA, OPEC)
dataTypes.derived: Calculated from official inputs using a transparent, documented methodology
dataTypes.simulated: Hypothetical what-if scenario or prototype value not sourced from official data

components.geopoliticalComponent: Regional instability and conflict exposure, normalized 0-100
components.chokepointExposure: Percentage of India crude flowing through the route, scaled to 0-100
components.supplierConcentration: HHI-style concentration measure of supplier import shares, scaled to 0-100
components.logisticsComponent: Transit time and disruption probability, normalized 0-100

riskScoreFormula.normalization: All components normalized to 0-100. Final score capped at 0-99.

supplierScoreFormula.normalization: Each factor normalized to 0-100 (higher = better). Lower cost and transit increase score; higher capacity and reliability increase score.

oilFlowMbd.description: Oil transit flow through a chokepoint
